comparison.objective: Mount and extend a telescoping rack rail until both ends latch; not tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rail support, peg-hole alignment, telescoping extension, and latching versus counterholding, tool insertion, fine rotational adjustment, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Both rail ends seated and latched, rail self-supporting after release versus two compliant cycles and a retained damper setting.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is generic; multi-end structural mounting is a different tested ability. Detailed alignment and latch thresholds are absent.
